info.title: How TTK is calculated
info.aggregate: Rating is based on average TTK: for each weapon we take ~400 random setups (HP 400–800, vitality 1.0–1.3), head hits, sharpening 15 and best AP ammo. Ranks S–E are assigned by the average TTK relative to the best weapon in the category with a 0.05 s step.
